content:
maria: Drafting the internal RN for the infra + runtime changes landing tonight. Posting the short snippet below — please eyeball pinning/rollback bits and call out any missing ops instructions.

maria: TL;DR: runtime v2.3.1 with kernel selection fix, improved batching heuristics, and a new autoscale policy. Affects hosted + dedicated. No model changes.

maria: Proposed internal blurb: 
```
Heads-up: Tonight we’re deploying runtime v2.3.1 (kernel selection + batching). Expected impact: lower tail latency for long-sequence requests. No model changes. Canary window: 20m at 5% traffic. Rollback: automatic fallback to v2.3.0 if 3+ CPU/GPU OOMs or error rate > 1.5% over 5m.
Action: ops oncall to monitor latency/ooms, product to watch customer-impacting errors.
```

jamal: quick q — canary at 5% enough? previous rollout we did 10% for node-heavy tiers. :thinking:

alex: I'd prefer 5% for first 20m then 25% for next 40m if no regressions. Less blast radius.

maria: ok plan: 5% x 20m -> 25% x 40m -> full. Update RN to reflect.

maria: Pinning note: hosted defaults to auto-variant. We're going to explicitly pin the dedicated pool to runtime:v2.3.1 during the window. Add a note for account holders in the RN: "Dedicated customers will be pinned to runtime:v2.3.1; contact support to delay."

ops-oncall: Rollback criteria checklist (copied from runbook):
- >=3 OOMs in 5m across pooled GPUs -> immediate rollback.
- Error rate >1.5% sustained for 5m -> trigger canary rollback.
- Latency P95 increases >30% vs baseline for 10m -> page SRE.
- If rollback, run `./scripts/rollback-runtime --version v2.3.0 --force` and notify #eng-sre + #support.

maria: added the ops checklist into the RN snippet. Also added the quick command to the ops play.

jamal: can you add the bit about model pin compatibility? some dedicated customers pin to quantized variants and we've seen mismatches before.

maria: good catch. Added: "Model variant compatibility: runtime v2.3.1 is compatible with quantized and int8 variants. If customers use custom kernels, ticket to support required"

deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] runtime:v2.3.1 -> rolling canary at 2026-09-10T02:00:00Z; owner: maria; canary: 5% for 20m. Link: https://deploys.internal/release/6432109876

alex: looks good. small nit: swap 'No model changes' -> 'No model weights or version changes' to be explicit.

maria: done. Final RN posted to #eng-releases and pinned. Will paste canonical copy to the staff channel 30m before deploy. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
